**Security: pass-with-notes**, delta only, at `001a3b8406f694c2b77ff69dddda5ae47e69a480`.

The complete tracked `.cargo/config.toml` has exactly two active settings: `[build] jobs = 4` and `[env] RUST_TEST_THREADS = { value = "4", force = false }` (lines 12-18). No registry, source, rustflags, linker, tool, path or credential-helper configuration is present. No scoped injection or C19/C21 disclosure found.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new delta vulnerability | - |

The justfile exports and added echo lines are removed; justfile matches the PR base. Shared-build's executable mappings, lock and disk-floor handling remain unchanged. The previous direct-justfile-export note is retired.

Retained prior qualifications: caller-supplied `RUST_TEST_THREADS` remains unvalidated environment data, not executed code; shared-build's decimal/positive-result check has no explicit overflow/range guard. The configuration provides defaults, not a non-overridable fleet maximum.

Local and remote heads agree; worktree clean; PR CLEAN and ready; all reported checks succeeded. Exact-head [CI 42444630104](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42444630104) and [Delivers 42444662796](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42444662796) are the execution evidence. The author's configuration-precedence/env-isolation probes were not independently rerun.

No local cargo/builds/tests/scripts, installs, global Cargo or credential reads, product edits or production/pane/process operations.
